Pattern.Intent: Preferred approach: SUT designed with injection seams is exercised against real `vi.fn()` stubs. No `vi.mock`, no operator confirm-gate triggered, no global patching — yet the test is fully isolated from the network.
Pattern.Why: No `vi.mock`, no `vi.spyOn`, no `globalThis.fetch` patching: SUT exposes injection seams (`httpRequest`, `store`) and the test passes typed `vi.fn()`s through them. Unified factory reused; case differs only by `response` override.
